label: D1 after an a1 choice that went rare to S2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2). It fires when the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (prev_action==1, prev_state==2), whether or not that trial was rewarded. Dev precision is 0.98, recall 0.66, mass recall 0.79. Activations are somewhat larger after unrewarded a1-rare trials: that subset holds 57% of the mass but only 46% of the active steps. Most misses are D1 steps on the first trial of a window (rel -3, about 16% of the mass), where the window does not include the previous trial, so the predicate cannot be evaluated there. These D1 steps are mostly followed by a1, so they are probably the same condition. The rest are weak low-quartile activations at other D1 steps that precede a1. The feature does not fire after a2 choices or after common a1 trials (a1 to S1). Its policy logit is moderately pro-a1 (2.8 to 8), which fits the model-based tendency to stay with a1 after rare-unrewarded trials. Every variable used is observed at D1.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & last=a1 S2 r (+5.43), phase=D1 & before=a1 S2 u (+4.50), phase=D1 & last=a1 S2 u (+3.39), phase=D1 & rel=1 (+3.14), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 8 (9 = highest) (+2.97), prev_state=2 (+2.95). Lower it: phase=GO (-8.51), phase=D2 (-8.11), choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (-5.20), prev_state=1 (-5.19).
